semantics.exclusiveGateway: evaluates conditions/default and selects exactly one outgoing flow
semantics.inclusiveGateway: OR split activates all true outgoing flows, OR join waits for active incoming branches
semantics.eventBasedGateway: race between event subscriptions; first event wins, siblings cancelled
semantics.eventSubProcess: scoped event subscription with interrupting/non-interrupting start
semantics.transaction: transaction scope with cancel and compensation lifecycle
semantics.compensation: completed activity registry and compensation handler execution
semantics.multiInstance: parallel/sequential instance expansion with completion condition
semantics.callActivity: called process scope invocation and return mapping
semantics.messageCorrelation: message name/key based delivery to waiting subscriptions
semantics.timerScheduling: timer jobs registered and fired deterministically
semantics.errorPropagation: scope walk to matching error handler
semantics.escalationPropagation: scope walk with interrupting/non-interrupting handler behavior

supportLevelV31: reference-semantics foundation, not production runtime persistence
